learningObjectives: Identify performance bottlenecks in Python programs.
Use profiling concepts to measure execution time and resource usage.
Choose appropriate optimization techniques based on measured results.

activities.title: Optimization Workflow
activities.instruction: Arrange the optimization workflow in the correct order.

content.concept: Effective optimization starts with measurement, identifies the actual bottleneck, applies a targeted change, and measures again to verify the result.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Complexity Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose the complexity that best matches the described algorithm.

content.concept: Big-O notation describes how an algorithm's resource requirements grow as input size increases. It helps identify algorithms that may become expensive at scale.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Profiler Metrics
activities.instruction: Click each profiling metric to understand what it tells you.

content.concept: Profilers help locate expensive parts of a program by reporting information such as function call counts and execution time.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Shows how many times a function was called.
Shows the total time spent inside the function itself, excluding time in called functions.
Shows cumulative time spent in the function and functions it called.
Identifies the function associated with the profiling measurement.

activities.title: Optimization Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the optimization that directly addresses the measured bottleneck.

content.concept: Optimization should be driven by profiling evidence. For example, repeated linear searches may benefit from a set or dictionary when appropriate, while excessive repeated computation may benefit from caching.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Replace repeated membership checks in a large collection with a set
Increase the number of print statements
config.answer: Replace repeated membership checks in a large collection with a set
